Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1.
2. Heard Sri Vinay Mishra, Advocate, holding brief of Sri Ahmad Ali Siddiqui, counsel for the applicant, Sri Ankit Srivastava, learned counsel for the State and perused the record.

3. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant Yaseen @Golu with the prayer to quash the entire criminal proceeding including the charge sheet no. 27/19 submitted by the Investigating Officer on 23.1.2019 in Case Crime No. 454 of 2018, u/s 363/366/376 I.P.C. and 3/4 POCSO Act, P.S.- Kotwali, District Budaun.

4. After some arguments, learned counsel for the applicant has made a statement at the Bar, on Yaseen @ Golu vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57725982/
1 instructions, that he does not want to press prayers made in the instant application and states that the applicant is ready to surrender before the concerned trial court and seek his bail and that his release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another: (2021) 10 SCC 773.
5.

entities.text: Yaseen @ Golu vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another: (2021) 10 SCC 773
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned AGA states that he has no objection to the aforesaid prayer made by learned counsel for the applicant for not pressing the other prayers made in the instant application.

6. In view of the above, in case the applicant appears/ surrenders before the concerned trial court within two weeks from today and seeks bail, his release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra).
Till the aforesaid period, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.
7. With the aforesaid observations, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is finally disposed off.
